title: Compose exact capacity/HBM gathers through concurrent shared-mesh ingress
hypothesis: Sixteen source-local packetizers, receive-before-transmit descriptor installation, and payload-counted layer barriers can replace abstract K/V NoC movement without serializing the four HBM corner sources.

direct_comparison.primary_question: Can exact transient-refill and direct-HBM payloads traverse the real 4x4 mesh into resident or canonical ingress ports with concurrent sources, preserved metadata, and end-to-end backpressure?
include: one independent span packetizer per physical source endpoint
four concurrent HBM corner sources and owner-local resident traffic
per-destination descriptor ownership through terminal packet completion
same-node, multi-hop, resident-write, and canonical-ingress payload paths

remaining_abstractions: Canonical ejection still requires K/V target-control adaptation into the exact transposers.
The one-buffer V ingress still lacks measured fill/drain overlap alternatives.
Inferred K/Q, resident, and cluster stores require characterized SRAM substitution.
The external HBM controller and PHY remain outside the RTL boundary.
